title: GPT-6 Astra System Card (2026-09-03)
abstract: GPT-6 Astra System Card (2026-09-03). Sentences naming BioTIER from the system-card corpus.
text:
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] 10.2.4.2 External Evaluations of Bio Safeguards - SecureBio SecureBio also had access to a safeguard configuration for safeguard testing using BioTIER to test whether safeguards refused harmful requests while allowing benign requests.
[openai-gpt-6-astra-system-card] BioTIER counts both full blocks and model-jury graded “soft” refusals, where a response is judged not to substantively answer the prompt.
